📢 Venomous black spitting cobra spotted in Serangoon Gardens; NParks monitoring ar...
articles.content: He added that NParks' contractors were immediately activated to survey the area and locate the snake after each reported sighting. However, the reptile was not found during these surveys. “NParks will continue to monitor the area and relocate any cobras sighted,” he added. On its website, NParks said that the snake is typically found in forests, parks and gardens. It may also be found in terrestrial and urban areas. The black spitting cobra is known to feed on small animals such as rats and toads
